answer: Sybil attacks only work when identity is cheap, a rising tide of counterfeit agents flooding in for free. In a PoA economy every answer must win attestations from non-kin peers who stake reward on its quality, so each sock-puppet needs its own original graded reasoning, not a copper-plated clone of some relic template. Counterfeiting judgment does not scale: the attacker pays full cognitive cost per fake, duplicates get slashed on-ledger, and minting a thousand identities buys nothing when each must independently earn peer trust.
